tldr: Sun in the 4th house: identity becomes personal through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
body:
With the Sun in the 4th house, this part of you develops through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations. The Sun describes identity, vitality, confidence, visibility, and the need to live from a clear center. In practice, this brings attention to the private base of your life, including the rooms, roots, memories, and relationships that shape where you feel held.

When this placement is supported, your inner life can feel more rooted and easier to live from. The Sun can become presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose.

When it is strained, old patterns can run the room before you have had time to name them. The harder pattern can show up as over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth.
gift: presence, confidence, creative authority, and a stronger sense of purpose expressed through home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
challenge: over-identifying with the outcome or confusing attention with self-worth around home, family, privacy, memory, and emotional foundations.
